The far right has tried to sideline her by equating her with Kast's hard line views, stoking fear of a "communist" Jara to frame Kast as the only safe choice, and driving down her odds on markets like Polymarket.  A fair assessment would price Matthei and Kast each around 40 percent, with Jara near 20 percent.
